blocks.html: requirement PRS_E2E_00299 [PRS_E2E_00299] Upstream: RS_E2E_08528

blocks.text_en: The E2E_P02Check() function shall • decrement SyncCounter by 1 and set Status to E2E_P02ST A TUS_SYNC if the following conditions are true: • the calculated DeltaCounter is within the parameters of 1 and MaxDeltaCounter (i.e. 1 =/< DeltaCounter =/< MaxDeltaCounter); and • the value of the NoNewOrRepeatedDataCounter is less than or equal to MaxNoNewOrRepeatedData (i.e. State NoNewOrRepeatedDataCounter =/< Config MaxNoNewOrRepeatedData); and • the SyncCounter exceeds
